title: Google Balls Mod
body:
# google balls mod for minecraft
![the mod's icon, depicting 4 colored balls. green, yellow, red, and blue.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0595b416cb150abed09a188da3e57544d7330a3b.png)

this is the google balls mod for minecraft forge/neoforge 1.20.1! it adds stuff like:
- the 4 google balls
- google balls block
- google balls ore

... and more! find out for yourself!
